reason: The official RCSB CCD HEM ideal SDF could not be sanitized by the RDKit/Meeko template path because the metal-containing heme representation triggered an explicit valence error. The run stopped before receptor PDBQT preparation and before Vina execution.

observations.failure_message: Explicit valence for atom O is greater than permitted; official RCSB HEM ideal SDF is not parseable by the active RDKit template path

closure.decision: Do not construct manual Fe/HEME atom types, charges or custom metal chemistry merely to force execution inside this program.
closure.rationale: A target-specific metalloprotein parameterization effort would constitute a new scientific-method development project and falls outside the frozen MOLDISC-006 question.
closure.unchanged_scientific_conclusion: No valid docking score or pose was produced for N-H against 1P2Y.

preserved_history: v1.0 INVALID_PREPARATION: Open Babel produced an empty receptor PDBQT and zero-valued Vina outputs; no valid evidence.
v1.1 INDETERMINATE_TARGET_TEMPLATE: Meeko default/automatic templates could not resolve HEM; Vina not executed.
v1.2 INDETERMINATE_TARGET_PREPARATION: official RCSB HEM ideal SDF failed the active RDKit/Meeko metal-containing template path; Vina not executed.
